company.name: Refine
company.shortDescription: Refine is a react-based web application development platform that offers a wide range of software services.
company.description: Refine provides a react-based web application development platform to assist businesses in producing better web applications with fewer resources and less time invested. Refine provides a ton of pre-built functionality for quick development without sacrificing utmost customizability. Refine removes the repetitive tasks required by CRUD operations and provides industry-standard solutions.

productsAndServices.description: A React-based meta-framework for building CRUD-heavy web applications like internal tools, admin panels, dashboards, and B2B apps.
productsAndServices.name: Refine React Meta-Framework

productsAndServices.description: Pre-built connectors for 15+ backend services including REST APIs, GraphQL, NestJS CRUD, Airtable, Strapi, Supabase, Hasura, Firebase, and others.
productsAndServices.name: Refine Data Providers and Connectors

productsAndServices.description: Integration support for multiple UI frameworks including Ant Design, Material UI, Mantine, Chakra UI, Tailwind CSS, and Headless UI.
productsAndServices.name: Refine UI Framework Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Built-in support for authentication and fine-grained access control using widely accepted models like ACL, RBAC, and ABAC, with native integration for identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, Amazon Cognito, and Google Cloud Identity.
productsAndServices.name: Refine Authentication and Authorization

productsAndServices.description: A self-hosted version of Refine designed for enterprise compliance, performance, and stability, offering priority support, training, and consulting services.
productsAndServices.name: Refine Enterprise Edition
